title: Vietnamese-Style Braised Cabbage
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish that highlights the unique flavors of Vietnam. The combination of ingredients and cooking method brings out the tender and slightly sweet taste of cabbage.
instructions: Heat the kho to in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the garlicky and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the nappa cabbage and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add the kissed and cook for 1 minute, until the cabbage is coated.
Add the ca and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, until the cabbage is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
